source: User-provided local_wht_probe.json; local 50GB WHT and 121GB gzip mosaics were not uploaded
interpretation: v13 0.882119 deg2 is entire image rectangle, NOT survey footprint; positive WHT must be sampled/integrated.
COSMOS-Web 30mas WHT tiles do not carry celestial WCS in first header. Use verified SCI WCS/corner metadata, not arbitrary alignment.
Neither file collection exposes WHT units/calibration in first header. WHT>0 cannot be relabeled as F444W 26.2 AB selection area.
The 80 files do not include F356W observations for astrometric detectability.
Follow-up script samples v13 WHT directly in bounded memory, saves compact spatial grids and 125 candidate-center WHT values. No WHT recompression or redownload.
